integrity: Mathematical proof and reproducibility script provided. Numeric Padovan sequence is previously known; this is an object-specific enumeration and comparison, not a claim of a new sequence.
scientific_limitations: Exact results only for alternating binary hosts (01)^k; not a maximization theorem for arbitrary hosts. Infinite conclusions rest on run enumeration and rational generating functions; finite verification does not establish novelty. Undiscovered equivalent published specializations are possible.
title: Padovan enumeration of minimal absent subsequences of alternating binary words
